name: Obadiah
title: Obadiah — Edom’s Pride Judged
tagline: As you have done, it shall be done to you.
purpose: Announce judgment on fraternal violence and pride.
christ: The kingdom shall be the LORD’s — consummated in Christ.
spirit: God defends His people when brothers stand aloof.
jesus_in_this_book: The kingdom shall be the LORD’s — consummated in Christ.
how_to_read: Short book, long memory — do not gloat over a brother’s fall.
watchman_charge: When your brother burns, do not loot the gate.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
